title: On the equivalence of BV notions in metric measure spaces
summary: The aim of the paper is to compare in detail several notions of $BV$ space of functions of bounded variation in metric measure spaces $({\rm X},\mathsf{d},\mathfrak{m})$. Informally, they can be grouped in two classes, either by a relaxation procedure starting from a class of nicer functions (and with different notions of pseudo-gradient in the relaxation procedure) or by requiring good behaviour along a rich class of absolutely continuous curves.
